topics.title: The Sun
topics.description: The Sun is the star at the center of our solar system. It gives Earth light and heat, making life possible.

topics.title: Mercury
topics.description: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun. It is small, rocky, and has extreme temperatures.

topics.title: Earth
topics.description: Earth is our home planet. It has liquid water, oxygen, land, and many forms of life.

topics.title: Mars
topics.description: Mars is known as the Red Planet because of its reddish surface. Scientists study Mars to learn if life once existed there.

topics.title: Jupiter
topics.description: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system. It is a gas giant with a famous storm called the Great Red Spot.
